purpose: Reconstruct the Cycle 20 prospective 2026 shadow population and independently prove, row by row, that every FORECAST_FROZEN probability was issued strictly before its contest kickoff bound and strictly before its declared pregame cutoff. The audit never regenerates a forecast, never revises a probability and never reads an outcome.

verdicts.TEMPORAL_PROOF_COMPLETE: Every required binding is present and every ordering requirement holds strictly. The row remains scorable.
verdicts.MISSED_CUTOFF_NO_BACKFILL: The row carries every required binding but was issued at or after its declared pregame cutoff deadline, or at or after its kickoff bound. The row is permanently non-scorable and must never be regenerated.
verdicts.FAIL_CLOSED_INSUFFICIENT_TEMPORAL_PROOF: At least one required binding is absent, unparseable or inconsistent with the reconstructed population. The row fails closed into the truthful non-scored state.

non_frozen_row_explanations.UNSUPPORTED_ENTITY: At least one participant of the contest does not resolve to the national spine, so no probability was ever emitted and there is nothing to prove temporally.
non_frozen_row_explanations.MISSING_REQUIRED_FEATURES_ABSTAIN: The candidate abstained because a required feature was unavailable at snapshot time. The row carries a null probability and is not a forecast.

probability_identity_rule: sha256 over the canonical JSON tuple of ncaa_contest_id, candidate_id, model_identity, feature_identity, code_identity, snapshot_identity and the probability rounded to eight decimal places.
kickoff_bound_rule: The audit consumes the predecessor conservative lower bound verbatim. It never recomputes, relaxes or advances a kickoff instant, because relaxing a bound would retroactively make a late forecast look timely.
taxonomy_correction_rule: Each audited contest receives the corrected Week Zero or Week One label published by the BAT-661 calendar gate, keyed on the official published game date. Membership is never changed by relabeling; a label change with a membership change is a hard failure.
